posts.meta_description:
50K likes, 233 comments - hollywoodreporter on October 21, 2026: "Charli D‘Amelio — the reigning queen of TikTok — is taking command of an empire she helped build before she was old enough to vote.⁠
⁠
For a generation of girls, @charlidamelio represented the ultimate social media success story. You didn’t need a Hollywood agent — you could become famous in your bedroom, just by being yourself. The catch: Once being yourself became your job, you might never get to stop working.⁠
⁠
Coming off a 10-month run in Broadway’s '& Juliet' — in which she sang and danced in the ensemble cast, earning some good reviews — Charli moved into a house in Valley Village, California, all by herself, earlier this year. The place represents something more than just a first home: At 22, Charli has separated herself professionally and financially from the family with whom she built her extraordinary career, she tells @nancyjosales.⁠
⁠
"I’m at the point now where I can see that I’ve lived a pretty amazing life, and I’m getting what I feel is like my second chance to do this the way that I want to do it. I love the person that I’m turning out to be”⁠
⁠⁠
Charli opens up about carving out her own path, learning to separate from the family empire, and what peace looks like after growing up online⁠ in THR's Creators Issue cover story at the link in bio.⁠
⁠
Visual Media Director: Ash Barhamand @ash_mack⁠
Artistic and Fashion Director (and Styling): Alison Edmond @edmondalison ⁠
Writer: Nancy Jo Sales @nancyjosales⁠
Photographer: Emman Montalvan @emmanmontalvan⁠
Creative Director: Ada Guerin @guerin_ad⁠
Visual Media Producer: Anthony Echavarria @whosanthony85⁠
Fashion Assistant: Marley Pearson @marleyyluna⁠
Production Assistant: Elliot Pearson @elpearsonart⁠
Hair: Hayley Heckmann @hayleyheckmann⁠
Makeup: Liv Madorma @livmadorma⁠
Wardrobe: @elisabettafranchi dress @hueb earrings @wolford tights @ysl shoes".
